verdict.rationale: Buzz ships an official CLI, the buzz-cli crate, documented with broad commands: channels create, repos protect set, workflows trigger/approve, and gif search. It is AI-native by design: the ACP harness has agents reply through the Buzz CLI, and the bundled managed-agent skill (name: buzz-cli) teaches agents to use it for messaging, channels, workflows, repos, memory and owner-reviewed agent drafts. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use, and documented installation/distribution and machine-readable output details.
